Do not redraw the Image 2 armor; Image 2 only demonstrates the clean flat visual rendering.

Extract/reconstruct target: TOP LEFT CARD icon, at x130..228 y288..377 in the 1672x941 reference: two slim crossed pointed swords in an X, thin long blades and small straight crossguards, tiny tan laurel twigs at the lower-left and lower-right. Blade tips are near the upper corners and handles near bottom corners. Keep the modest short leaves, very small guards, and slender reference swords, do NOT widen blades or enlarge the laurel. Closely preserve its near-square silhouette.
